base: T3_rev6 row 38 / N2 (correct temperature sign, T11)
rationale: Author-directed: bring the <100> loop cost down until 10-15 nm <100> loops are attainable.  Under the shipped calibration (n_ref=50, T*=450) the crossover temperature rises steeply with size -- 450 C at n=50 but 693 C at n=2981 (12.5 nm) -- so a 10-15 nm <100> loop can never be favoured at the 350 C where the database reports it as DOMINANT. That is why T11 matched the character but left d_mean 4x short.  calibrate() sets Fhat_100_0 from dF(n_ref,T*)=0, so n_ref is the cost knob; n_ref=2982 with T*=330 lowers Fhat_100_0 by 22% (0.4799 -> 0.3757) and puts the sign flip on the measured sizes.  Run at the MEASURED doses (15.0 / 16.3), 8 h cap; timed-out rows still carry their ladder rungs.
